verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents typed official SDKs for JavaScript, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, Rust, Java, Swift, Dart, and .NET, plus dedicated official pages for the JavaScript and Python clients, a first-party Laravel Scout driver, and React InstantSearch pairing. The 'kept current' part of the story is weaker: one production user reports the Rails gems falling out of step with the server and staying incompatible for a while after fixes shipped. Missing for 10: evidence of SDK release cadence or version parity with the server, documentation depth for most non-JS/Python SDKs, and independent corroboration that SDKs stay current (the only hands-on report on this is negative for Rails).
